FISCAL NOTE
Senate Bill 359
Committee: Veterans, Military Affairs and Sponsor: Senator Randy Price
Public Safety
Analyst: Michael Russo Date: 03/12/2026
Senate Bill 359 as introduced would, if ratified, authorize Chambers County to levy and collect
a two mill ad valorem fire protection tax on certain owners of real property in the county. This
would increase annual ad valorem tax collections in the county by an undetermined amount
dependent upon the value of property, of which the proceeds would be distributed to
associations and entities that exclusively provides volunteer fire protection services in the
county proportionate to the area served, as determined by the State Forestry Commission.
This bill could also increase the administrative obligations of the State Forestry Commission by
an undetermined amount to determine the service area of each qualifying volunteer fire
protection association or entity.
Additionally, this bill would increase the proclamation expenses of the Governor, paid from the
State General Fund, by an estimated $100,000 for the fiscal year ending September 30, 2027.
